subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway `config.patch`?
rationale: The source-level behavior is clear, but the repair changes Feishu's public config shape and may affect the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so maintainer product and security-boundary intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to support the shared nested preview controls while preserving current defaults and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

options.title: Only soften exec progress wording
options.body: Reduce scary benign non-zero exec wording while keeping Feishu streaming boolean-only, which is smaller but leaves no supported way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway streaming toggle
options.body: Permit gateway `config.patch` to change `channels.feishu.streaming`, which helps recovery but broadens an operator-controlled path and still does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to support the shared nested preview controls while preserving current defaults and leave `config.patch` protection unchanged unless a separate security review approves it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Feishu Card Kit streaming path and boolean config surface that this decision would extend.
